# Chinese Mountains
An independent guide to every famous peak in China. Interactive maps, detailed guides, comparison tools, and a 3-step quiz to help you find your perfect mountain.

## Key Pages
- Home (Decision Engine): https://chinesemountains.org/
- Explore All Mountains: https://chinesemountains.org/explore
- Best Mountains Ranking: https://chinesemountains.org/best
- Compare Mountains Tool: https://chinesemountains.org/compare
- Travel Guides: https://chinesemountains.org/guides
- Photo Gallery: https://chinesemountains.org/gallery
- About: https://chinesemountains.org/about

## Mountain Detail Pages
Each mountain has a dedicated page at /mountains/{slug}/ with elevation, difficulty, best season, highlights, cultural significance, how to get there, and FAQs.
- Mount Huangshan (Yellow Mountain): https://chinesemountains.org/mountains/huangshan/
- Zhangjiajie: https://chinesemountains.org/mountains/zhangjiajie/
- Mount Tai (Taishan): https://chinesemountains.org/mountains/taishan/
- Mount Hua (Huashan): https://chinesemountains.org/mountains/huashan/
- Mount Emei (Emeishan): https://chinesemountains.org/mountains/emeishan/
- Mount Everest (Qomolangma): https://chinesemountains.org/mountains/everest/
- Jade Dragon Snow Mountain: https://chinesemountains.org/mountains/jade-dragon/

## Data Coverage
25 mountains across 7 regions of China, including elevations, difficulty ratings, seasonal recommendations, UNESCO status, and cultural significance.
